entities.summary: Landon Christopher Ferraro is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre and current Vancouver Canucks analyst for Sportsnet. Ferraro was drafted 32nd overall by the Detroit Red Wings in the 2009 NHL Entry Draft, with whom he began his NHL career.
